migrations.reason: Replace post-spawn tier receipt checks with the simpler Superpowers-style general-purpose implementer/reviewer loop.

evals.prompt: /tk-implement fresh Ready delegated ticket: approved owned paths are skills/tk-implement/SKILL.md and .tigerkit/implement.md; resolved model/effort; `.tigerkit/session.md` current-host routing is Status: Ready
evals.expected_output: approved session selector로 delegated worker/reviewer를 실행하고 owned paths exactly [skills/tk-implement/SKILL.md, .tigerkit/implement.md]만 변경한 뒤 한 commit과 requested/realized model receipt

assertions.criterion: The one new implementation commit changes exactly the approved implementation path set, excluding the post-commit .tigerkit/implement.md receipt. An approved active-host selector is used before a general-purpose implementer, then a fresh reviewer returns Spec compliance and Task quality verdicts. The receipt records requested selector, host-exposed realized model or unavailable, commit SHA, ancestry, and owned paths.

evals.prompt: /tk-implement fresh Ready direct ticket: one bounded low-risk owned path, exact R/AC and focused check are approved; do not spawn a subagent
evals.expected_output: current context가 direct executor로 focused check와 self-review 뒤 한 commit과 receipt를 만들며 session routing, implementer, SDD reviewer를 사용하지 않는다

assertions.criterion: Direct implementation does not read or propose session model routing and does not spawn an implementer, corrective worker, or SDD reviewer. It stays inside the one approved unit, runs focused verification and self-review, then creates one verified commit and receipt.

evals.prompt: /tk-implement fresh Ready delegated ticket but `.tigerkit/session.md` has no current-host routing; available selectors are fast-model, balanced-model, strong-model
evals.expected_output: exact session Markdown addition proposal and Status: Pending before worker or mutation

assertions.criterion: Propose the exact active-host `.tigerkit/session.md` block using confirmed selectors and wait for approval. Do not write the session file, dispatch a worker, edit product files, stage, commit, or create a success receipt.

evals.expected_output: Status: Unverifiable, no mutation; clean isolated checkout에서는 .tigerkit/implement.md를 만들지 않음

assertions.criterion: In the clean isolated checkout, this failure path creates no receipt or new mutation. This does not prove preservation of a pre-existing receipt because the current harness cannot pre-seed one.
